prompt: You're a data analyst for an e-commerce company. Last week's sales dropped, how would you analyze this?
response: To analyze the drop in sales, you could start by creating a histogram to visualize the distribution of sales amounts. This will give you an idea of how sales varied across different products or categories. You could also create a scatter plot to see if there's a relationship between sales and other factors like time or day of the week. This will help you identify any patterns or trends in the data.
